title: HumanConsult 2.0: the orchestrator asking a person for something the machine cannot measure
description: Raised when a decision would be materially better with knowledge this loop cannot generate: an assay the machine cannot run, an unpublished in-house result, or a judgement call. It always states what happens if nobody answers, so the loop never silently stalls.

question.description: Written for a person, answerable in a few sentences or a number

why_it_matters.description: Which hypothesis or failed criterion this bears on

why_not_feasible.description: The physical or process reason, e.g. fixation steps break the closed path

expected_gain.description: Honest, qualitative statement of what an answer buys. No invented probabilities.

affects.description: Protocol steps or parameters an answer would change

blocking.description: true = the loop waits; false = the fallback runs and the consult stays open

action.description: What the orchestrator will do if nobody answers

consequence.description: What is lost or left uncertain by taking the fallback

options.description: Concrete choices offered to the person, so answering is a selection rather than an essay

evidence_status.description: What kind of knowledge this is. Only unpublished_in_house_result and published_but_unretrieved may become a cited protocol value; expert_judgement stays a design choice.

citable_as.description: Provenance the literature agent may give a value derived from this answer
